item.description: Fixed • Presentable Mode now hides your MCP server and Skill names in the Overview. In "Where it went", servers and Skills read "Server 1" and "Skill 1", and so do servers you set up but never called. MCP tools in Tool usage carry the same masked server name. Sizes, shares and call counts stay as they are

New • The session browser totals what you filtered: a line under the filters shows how many sessions match, what they cost together, their tokens and active time, and how many have no price yet. Select it to copy it. Presentable Mode hides the dollars • Filter sessions by git branch
Improved • Codex sessions now show their git branch, which Codex records whenever it runs in a repository. The first launch re-reads your sessions once to fill it in for older ones
Fixed • A new Claude Code session that stops at a permission prompt in its first seconds now gets its "waiting" alert. Before, it could stay silent if Actvt hadn't looked at the session yet

New • Actvt now knows the moment a Claude Code session needs you. A permission prompt or a question shows the session as waiting within seconds, not after 90 seconds of quiet, and a long, quiet tool call no longer reads as your turn. This uses the status newer Claude Code versions write; older ones keep the 90-second rule
Fixed • Codex sub-agents now appear inside the session that started them, instead of as separate sessions • pi sub-agents (pi-subagents) are now counted: their tokens and cost belong to the session that started them, and were missing before • Suggest tailnet hosts now says why it lists nothing on a Mac that has the Tailscale app but no Tailscale command-line tool, and points to adding a machine by name • Machines added under Remote Sessions need actvt-cli 0.10.1 to fold their sub-agents the same way, and Settings offers the update
